title: 身高一米六能否把妹？丨经典学员案例丨約會丨把妹丨情感丨戀愛丨約炮丨男性自我提升丨短期關係丨長期關係丨dating in china

timeline.summary: A roughly 1.6-meter student approaches women; Mikey discusses tension, composure and not pre-rejecting oneself because of height.
A longer interaction and further attempts lead to review of unclear immediate-date intent and speculative relationship interpretations.
Dense edited practice includes refusals, companions and partner disclosures; some persistence creates boundary risk.
The student reports 14 contacts and seven or eight refusals, then attributes results mainly to confidence and composure.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He advises not using height to reject oneself before another person has responded.
claims.conditions: Height can affect preferences and outcomes; one edited case cannot quantify the effect.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: The student's first improvement target is greater relaxation and less visible urge to escape the interaction.
claims.conditions: Do not turn composure into persistence after refusal.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: An immediate invitation should be clear rather than hidden in vague language.
claims.conditions: It must be easy to refuse and must end when declined.

claims.speaker: student
claims.statement: He reports collecting 14 contacts, receiving seven or eight refusals and seeing height as only a small factor.
claims.conditions: Unverified immediate recall, no attempt denominator, contact validation or follow-up.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He sometimes interprets initial resistance or a friend's intervention as evidence of hidden interest and encourages continued engagement.
claims.conditions: Unsafe inference; explicit refusal, withdrawal, marriage or companion intervention must not be overwritten by speculation.

examples.summary: The edited sequence shows repeated approaches by a short student, but does not provide a complete denominator or later outcomes.

speaker_attribution.speaker: Mikey
speaker_attribution.basis: Identified coach narrating and reviewing the field attempts.

speaker_attribution.speaker: student
speaker_attribution.basis: Closing numbers and causal interpretation are his self-report.

speaker_attribution.speaker: public participants
speaker_attribution.basis: Their edited responses cannot be converted into hidden-interest claims.

visual_findings: All 18 sampled frames were reviewed; they show public street approaches with blurred faces and a closing student interview/contact overlay.
Frames do not verify the student's height measurement, ownership or validity of contacts, later replies or dates.
Blurring reduces facial exposure but leaves clothing, locations, companions and interaction context visible.

permissions.reason: Duplicate formal source with edited outcome claims and unsafe persistence/hidden-interest interpretations.

limitations: Automatic transcript was not word-for-word audio checked.
Sparse frames do not equal continuous interaction review.
The numerical outcome and height conclusion are anecdotal self-report.
